suggestions.rationale_bands: The band lock keeps the modem on the carrier's main 5G bands, which usually improves stability. It can also reduce coverage where only other bands reach you. Bands the modem does not report as supported are left out, and deactivating the profile removes the lock.
suggestions.rationale_ttl: TTL and hop limit are set to 64 so traffic from devices behind the modem leaves with the same value as traffic from the modem itself. Deactivating the profile restores the previous values.

page.title: Custom SIM Profile

lte.title: LTE Tower
lte.description: Pin the 4G radio to as many as three cells, by channel and PCI.

nr_sa.title: 5G NR-SA Tower
nr_sa.description: Pin the 5G standalone radio to a single cell.

fields.scs_guess: Filled from the band {{band}} default. Verify it against your tower if the lock fails.
fields.scs_from_serving: Read from the cell the modem is camped on.

card.gate_nsa_body: Standalone locking needs the modem in SA mode. It is currently using 5G anchored to an LTE cell.
card.gate_lte_body: The modem is on LTE only, so there is no NR cell to pin.
card.empty_body: Pick a cell from the list above, or type a channel and PCI.

schedule.title: Lock schedule
schedule.description: Apply the tower lock only inside a daily window.
schedule.toast_no_targets: Set a lock target before scheduling
schedule.arm_warning: Saved, but the schedule isn't armed: {{reason}}
schedule.arm_reason_unit_absent: the scheduling service isn't installed on this device yet — update to the latest firmware to enable it

dialog.lock_lte_body_one: The modem drops its connection briefly and reattaches to {{summary}}. If that cell is unreachable you may lose service until the lock is removed.
dialog.lock_lte_body_other: The modem drops its connection briefly and reattaches to one of {{count}} cells. If none are reachable you may lose service until the lock is removed.
dialog.lock_nr_body: The modem drops its connection briefly and reattaches to {{summary}}. If that cell is unreachable you may lose service until the lock is removed.
dialog.unlock_body: The radio goes back to choosing its own cell. The connection drops briefly while it reattaches.

toast.incomplete: Fill in every field before locking
toast.no_targets: Enter a channel and cell ID first
toast.slots_full: All three LTE cells are already set

warning.service_enable_failed: The lock is active now, but it will not survive a reboot — the modem rejected the save command.
warning.persist_command_failed: "Keep lock after reboot" did not take. The modem rejected the save command.

error.title: Couldn't read tower lock state
error.body: The modem did not answer after three attempts. Nothing below reflects the radio's real lock state until this succeeds.
